title: How the First Wi‑Fi Router Turned a Coffee Shop Into a Network Hub

scenes.text: In 1999 a coffee shop in San Francisco hosted the first public Wi‑Fi hotspot
scenes.query: first public Wi‑Fi hotspot 1999 coffee shop

scenes.text: The 802.11b standard offered 11 Mbps and used the 2.4 GHz ISM band.
The router used a simple antenna made from a copper pipe, extending range to the whole block.
scenes.query: copper pipe Wi‑Fi antenna early router

scenes.label: ROOT OF WIFI
scenes.sub: From coffee shop to global connectivity.

scenes.text: Follow for daily tech you should actually know.

description: A look at the humble beginnings of public Wi‑Fi and the simple tech that made a café the first network hub. The story behind our daily connections.
